title: Unify Add a reference entry point (URL + optional file import)
description: One 'Add a reference' area: Paste a URL (unchanged) or, only with a curation session, Import a file (shared panel). Editor-facing copy free of engine terms. Specs: cancel/reject commits nothing; web candidate preview shows full model_representation and provenance; no session renders URL only. Part of PPY-7227ac (Kanbus forbids a task under a story).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented: ReferenceAddEntry (components/reference-add-entry.tsx) is the single Add a reference area; Paste a URL unchanged; Import a file only via useReferenceImport (session with priming + review). Specs: features_backend/newsroom_curation.feature (leave-preview-saves-nothing, web preview details + provenance), scripts/test-reference-add-entry.ts.
